hex_tooltip_demon_god_info: 😈 Demon god — harvest blocked ({0}/{1} HP) — master of the Pandemonium
hex_tooltip_demon_god_info_leveled: 😈 Demon god Level {2} — harvest blocked ({0}/{1} HP) — master of the Pandemonium
event_demon_god_discovered_body: A vast, motionless demon god sits at the heart of the Pandemonium. Its tentacles guard every approach.
event_demon_god_defeated_body: The master of the Pandemonium is no more. Silence falls over the arena.
hex_tooltip_volcano_info: 🌋 Volcano — harvest blocked — periodic eruptions (30 damage)
event_volcano_discovered_body: An active volcano threatens nearby cities. It erupts periodically, dealing cascade damage. Keep your settlements at a safe distance!
event_deepest_mine_placed_body: The dig site is open. Invest resources to dig down to the Underworld.
event_deepest_mine_dug_body: The Deepest Mine has broken through. An outpost awaits you in the Underworld.
event_underworld_lost_body: Your last outpost in the Underworld has been destroyed. Re-invest in the Deepest Mine to reopen access.
event_city_lost_to_terrain_body: The terrain changed under one of your cities and it can no longer stand there: no land left around it, or the terrain your people require is gone.
event_military_vertex_lost_to_terrain_be: The terrain changed under one of your Maritime Beacons, which is no longer surrounded by 3 water hexes: it is destroyed.
event_military_vertex_lost_to_terrain_fl: The terrain changed under one of your War Fleets, which is no longer surrounded by 3 water hexes: it is destroyed.
event_military_vertex_lost_to_terrain_ca: The terrain changed under one of your Mobile Camps, now submerged under 3 water hexes: it is destroyed.
event_surface_breach_placed_body: The dig site is open. Invest resources to dig up to the surface.
event_surface_breach_dug_body: The Breach has reached daylight. Your first surface city is founded.
event_surface_lost_body: Your last surface city has been destroyed. Re-invest in the Surface Breach to reopen access.
event_fairy_circle_body: The fairies share their crystals. Build an adjacent Alchemist Hut to harvest them.
event_ritual_collapsed_body: Lacking crystals or Mage Towers, one of your rituals has collapsed.
hex_tooltip_corruption_source:
🌀 Corruption Source
► Raises its hex's corruption by one level every 10 seconds, up to level {0}
► The only hex a Corruption Spire can be built on
► Finishing it destroys the Source, grants a prestige bonus for as long as the Spire stands on the island (×2 per Source level) and unlocks Corrupted Prestige
hex_tooltip_corruption_source_locked: 🌀 Corruption Source — raises its hex's corruption by one level every 10 seconds, up to level {0}
hex_tooltip_dominion_info: Dominion (lvl. {0}) — +{1}% harvest speed on this hex
hex_tooltip_corruption_spire: 🌑 Corruption Spire — under construction, does not reduce corruption yet; invest resources to complete it: it will destroy the Corruption Source beneath it, which grants a prestige bonus for as long as it stands on the island (×2 per Source level) and unlocks Corrupted Prestige
hex_tooltip_corruption_spire_built: 🌑 Corruption Spire — built: the Corruption Source beneath it was destroyed and its level turned into a prestige bonus, active for as long as the Spire stands on the island. Its level cannot be upgraded; it simply reduces corruption within a radius of {0} hex(es) by 1 level every 10s. Corrupted Prestige is unlocked
event_corruption_spire_placed_body: While under construction the Spire does not reduce corruption. Invest resources to complete it: it will then destroy the Corruption Source beneath it, and that Source's level becomes a permanent prestige bonus.
event_corruption_spire_built_body: The Corruption Source beneath the Spire is destroyed: its level is turned into a prestige bonus (×2 per level), granted for as long as the Spire stands on this island. The Spire has nothing left to receive — its level cannot be upgraded — and now simply reduces corruption within a radius of 1 hex by 1 level every 10 seconds.
event_corruption_spire_radius_upgraded_b: The Spire now reduces corruption within a radius of {0} hex(es) around it.
tooltip_corruption_spire_destroy: Demolishes the Spire so you can build a new one elsewhere, on another Corruption Source. Invested resources are lost, and the prestige bonus drops back to ×1 until a new Spire is completed.
event_corruption_spire_destroyed_body: The Spire no longer reduces corruption. You can now place a new one on another Corruption Source — its construction starts over from scratch, at full cost. The corruption-clearing prestige bonus is suspended until it is completed.
hex_tooltip_abyss_gate: 🌌 Abyss Gate — already reduces its corruption by 1 level/10s; invest resources to open it
hex_tooltip_abyss_gate_built: 🌌 Abyss Gate — opened, reduces its corruption by 1 level every 10s
event_abyss_gate_eligible_body: You have fully cleansed a corruption zone of level 4 or higher on this island: your Corruption Spire can now evolve into an Abyss Gate. Go check on it!
event_abyss_gate_placed_body: The Corruption Spire is evolving. Invest resources to complete the Abyss Gate.
event_abyss_gate_built_body: The Gate replaces the Corruption Spire: it keeps reducing its hex's corruption every 10 seconds.
event_abyss_lost_divine_essence_body: Your last city in the Abyss was destroyed: {0} divine essence(s) harvested this run are lost.
event_abyss_gate_lost_body: Your last city in the Abyss was destroyed: the entire Abyss map is lost. The Gate falls back to 50% investment: reinvest to generate a new map.
event_monument_investment_blocked_body: The city that gave access to {0} was destroyed: investment is blocked until a city touches its hex again.
hex_tooltip_pandemonium_gate: 🔥 Pandemonium Gate — invest resources to open it
event_pandemonium_gate_placed_body: A Pandemonium Gate gapes where the tentacle fell. Invest the same resources as the Abyss Gate to open it.
event_pandemonium_gate_built_body: The gate is crossed: a single island ringed by the Void, a demon god at its heart and eight tentacles to guard it.
hex_tooltip_divine_bones:
🦴 Divine Bones
► Invest Crystal and research points to purify them
► Each Purification grants 1 Divine Essence, capped at {0} at the current corruption level — prestige to raise it
► ⚠ While unpurified, they corrupt their hex by one level every 10 seconds, up to level {1}
► ⚠ Divine Essence is lost on prestige
hex_tooltip_divine_bones_purified: 🦴 Divine Bones — purified, a Divine Essence was granted
hex_tooltip_divine_bones_purified_no_ess: 🦴 Divine Bones — purified, but the Divine Essence cap was already reached: no essence granted
divine_bones_purified_message: Purified — a Divine Essence has been granted
divine_bones_purified_no_essence_message: Purified — Essence cap already reached, no essence granted
divine_bones_essence_status: Divine Essence: {0}/{1} — lost on prestige, except with Sacred/Reinforced Reliquary
event_divine_bones_purified_body: A Divine Essence has been granted. The Ascension menu is now available.
event_divine_bones_purified_no_essence_b: The Divine Essence cap was already reached: no essence granted. The amount of Essence that can be held equals the current corruption level — prestige to raise it. Divine Essence is lost on prestige, except up to 2 with Sacred/Reinforced Reliquary.
event_divine_essence_cap_reached_body: You hold {0} Divine Essence, the maximum your Corruption level allows. Further Purifications will grant nothing until that cap is raised — through a prestige, or a new divine power.
event_divine_essence_cap_below_ascension: The cap ({0}) stays below the {1} divine points required to ascend. Three ways to reach the threshold: the Sacred/Reinforced Reliquary, which keeps essences from one prestige to the next; the Necropolis, which raises divine points gained by 10% per level; or bringing Corruption to {1} to raise the cap.
prestige_tooltip_unlocks_divine_bones: Reveals the Divine Bones on Abyss islands
prestige_tooltip_temple_dominion_cap: to the Dominion cap per Temple level
prestige_tooltip_temple_dominion_protect: chance that the Dominion of a city with a Temple does not lose a level to Corruption
prestige_tooltip_void_route_cost_reducti: Already-built Void routes only count for two thirds in the next one's cost
prestige_tooltip_unlocks_observatory: Unlocks the Observatory (Mountain monument that lowers Void route costs)
prestige_tooltip_unlocks_necropolis: Unlocks the Necropolis (monument built on Divine Bones that raises the Divine Points of Ascension)
prestige_tooltip_temple_defense_bonus: Each Temple adds +1/3/6/10 defense to its city based on its level
prestige_tooltip_temple_monster_damage: damage per second to monsters around each Temple
prestige_tooltip_unlocks_arsenal_product: Unlocks Arsenal activation: produces 2 soldiers per Steel consumed (no production while inactive)
prestige_tooltip_crystal_generation_per_: passive magic crystal generation, per Laboratory
prestige_tooltip_smith_double_prod_chanc: chance to produce an extra Steel Weapon/Armor
event_civilization_discovered_body: A new civilization has been spotted in your vicinity.
event_civilization_destroyed_body: A civilization lost its last city and has disappeared.
event_soldier_starved_body: Some soldiers died from lack of food. Increase your food stockpile.
event_raid_missing_barracks_body: One of the cities nearest to the raid target has no Barracks.
event_war_herald_auto_reinforcement_conf: Auto-reinforcement is active and will override the War Herald's redirection within seconds.
event_wonder_discovered_body: A wonder stands on this hex. Harvesting here is impossible.
hex_tooltip_necropolis: ⚱ Necropolis (Level {0}) — +{1}% Divine Points on Ascension, harvest blocked
tech_harvest_tools_desc: +1 max level Sawmill, Mill, Quarry and Brickworks
tech_archivage_desc: +5% research point production speed per rank. Infinitely repeatable: cost doubles with every relaunch.
tech_grand_architecture_desc: +1 max level Market, Library and Barracks
tech_specialized_market_desc: +3 max level Market. All basic resources now sell at a 4:1 rate
tech_efficient_trading_desc: +1 bonus gold per 10 units sold at once
tech_automatic_market_desc: Automatically sells surplus basic resources (and Ore, Glass, Steel once Advanced Trading Posts is researched) in cities with a level 4+ Market
tech_advanced_trading_posts_desc: Unlocks selling Ore, Glass and Steel at the market, at 1/5 of their purchase price
tech_advanced_guilds_desc: Increases the automatic building construction speed of guilds by 10% per city in the empire
tech_grand_temple_construction_desc: Unlocks the Grand Temple, a unique building that automates Temple construction and adds a 0.5% prestige bonus per Temple built in the civilization
tech_automation_preset_desc: Unlocks 3 presets in the Automation tab, to cap the level construction automation must never exceed, building by building.
tech_steel_weapons_desc:
Unlocks the Weapon Smith (max level 2).
► Produces 1 Steel Weapon every 20s (faster per level)
► Consumes 2 Steel per Weapon
► Each city attack consumes 1 Weapon to deal 1 extra hit
tech_siderurgie_desc: The Smelter only consumes 3 Ore per smelt.
tech_volcanologie_desc: Studying volcanic soil reveals richer Ore veins: +15% chance to double the automatic harvest of Mines. Also reduces damage dealt by volcanic eruptions to the civilization's cities by 50%.
tech_volcanic_metallurgy_desc:
Unlocks the Volcanic Forge (unique building, max level 3).
► Passively generates Glass
► Boosts the civilization's Ore, Steel and Mithril production
► Must be built next to a discovered volcano
tech_steel_armor_desc:
Unlocks the Armor Smith (max level 2).
► Produces 1 Steel Armor every 20s (faster per level)
► Consumes 3 Steel per Armor
► When a soldier would die, consumes 1 Armor with a 50% chance to save them
tech_tempered_steel_desc: The Smelter produces +1 Steel per smelt.
tech_remparts_de_fer_desc: Reinforces the Palisade with ore (+1 max level).
tech_remparts_de_mithril_desc: Reinforces the Palisade with mithril (+1 max level).
tech_rail_logistics_desc: Reinforcements are sent twice as fast and their range increases by 1.
tech_mobile_camp_construction_desc:
Unlocks construction of the Mobile Camp, a military outpost.
► Min distance 2 from your other military locations
► Automatically destroyed if one of your cities is built at max distance 1 (no effect on enemy cities)
► Self-destructs after 300 seconds regardless
tech_entrainement_intensif_desc: +5% unit production speed per rank. Infinitely repeatable: cost doubles with every relaunch.
tech_war_herald_desc: Unlocks coordinated reinforcements to an allied city: redirects all reinforcement flows toward the target, except locations with an active attack flow.
tech_speleologie_desc: +25% Mine speed and +10 advanced resource storage.
tech_culture_fongique_desc: +25% Mushroom Farm speed and 25% chance to double their harvest.
tech_bois_de_champignon_desc: Allows Sawmills to harvest Wood from Mushroom Caves, at half speed compared to forests.
tech_sagesse_souterraine_desc: Knowledge drawn from the depths enriches your civilization. +10% prestige points earned per rank. Infinitely repeatable: cost doubles with every relaunch.
tech_void_walking_desc: Allows building routes between two Void hexes, like maritime routes. Each Void route also costs research points, with a cost that grows (×3 per route already built).
tech_void_compass_desc: Reveals the Divine Bones on Abyss islands generated after the first one — a mysterious remnant worth investigating.
tech_cartographie_souterraine_desc: +3% chance to discover a treasure on each new Underworld hex. Allows the Builders Guild to also automate road and outpost construction in the Underworld (separate toggles in the Automation tab).
tech_veille_souterraine_desc: Discreet sentinels watch the tunnels and deter incursions: +75% interval between border monster spawn attempts in the Underworld.
tech_demonologie_desc: +50% interval between border monster spawn attempts in the Underworld and the Abyss.
tech_resistance_a_la_corruption_desc: Your harvesters harden against the miasma: Corruption counts as 1 level lower for the harvest penalty (minimum level 1).
tech_pacte_abyssal_desc: A dark bargain struck with what whispers at the bottom of the Rift. +50% prestige points earned.
tech_theologie_de_l_ascension_desc: The ultimate study: what awaits beyond the Rift. +30% prestige points per Divine Bone purified on the island, compounding.
tech_acier_abyssal_desc: An alloy quenched in the flames of the Abyss: +25% chance to double the harvest for Forges, and the Smelter produces +1 Steel per smelt.
tech_magie_du_vide_desc: Drawing straight from the void: +25% total ritual power and -10% crystal cost of spells.
tech_pont_du_vide_desc: Unlocks the Void Bridge spell: for a price in crystals, one void road rises between two Void hexes, without costing a single research point.
tech_cartes_des_etoiles_desc: Unlocks the Observatory, a monument built on a surface Mountain. Each level lowers the research-point cost multiplier of Void routes, from × 3 down to × 2.4 once the Observatory is complete.
tech_necropole_divine_desc:
Unlocks the Necropolis, a monument built on unpurified Divine Bones.
► Construction consumes the bones, sacrificing the Divine Essence they held
► Each level raises the Divine Points earned on Ascension by 10%
tech_liturgie_funeraire_desc:
The chant of the dead makes the rites of Purification less costly the more they are repeated.
► Divine Bones Purification cost grows 10% slower with each Divine Essence already collected
► The first Purification of a cycle keeps its price: it is the later ones that get cheaper
tech_coeur_de_la_terre_desc: Your miners hear the heartbeat of the world: +50% Mine harvest speed.
tech_creuset_du_dominion_desc: Steel melts faster where your god reigns: each Smelter gains +3% speed per Dominion level on its city's hexes.
tech_omniscience_desc: Nothing escapes your scholars anymore: +50% research point generation speed.
tech_legion_eternelle_desc: An army that no longer knows rest: +25% unit production speed and +10 maximum soldiers per city.
tech_reliquaire_sacre_desc: The divine bones finally rest in a worthy shrine: -15% Divine Bones Purification cost and keep 1 Divine Essence on prestige.
tech_reliquaire_renforce_desc: A larger shrine for even more numerous relics: keep 1 additional Divine Essence on prestige (2 total).
tech_cartographie_du_vide_desc: The paths of nothingness can finally be charted: already-built Void routes only count for two thirds in the cost of the next one.
tech_dogme_de_l_emprise_desc:
Your god's doctrine takes root even under the rock.
► Dominion depth penalty: 1.5 per layer instead of 2
► ÷1.5 in the Underworld, ÷2.25 in the Abyss, ÷3.375 in the Pandemonium (instead of ÷2/÷4/÷8)
► Temples and spreading therefore push the Corruption back far more often down there
tech_evangelisation_desc: The divine word spreads on its own: +5% Dominion spread chance per level (Corruption stays at 10%).
tech_terre_consacree_desc: The blessed soil resists the miasma: 50% chance that Dominion on the hexes of a city with a Temple does not lose a level to Corruption.
tech_bastion_consacre_desc: Blessed walls hold fast: each Temple adds a fixed defense bonus to its city based on its level (+1/+3/+6/+10), and the city's defense regeneration is boosted by 1% per point of Dominion on its surrounding hexes.
tech_prospection_avancee_desc: +20% defense regeneration speed for Underworld cities.
tech_magic_initiation_desc: Unlocks the Growth ritual (+10% harvest speed per power).
tech_ardent_forge_ritual_desc: Unlocks the Ardent Forge ritual (+10% double harvest chance per power).
tech_clairvoyance_ritual_desc: Unlocks the Clairvoyance ritual (+15% research speed per power).
tech_martial_blessing_ritual_desc: Unlocks the Martial Blessing ritual (+3 max soldiers and +15% unit production per power).
tech_arcane_shield_ritual_desc: Unlocks the Arcane Shield ritual (+2 city defense and +15% regeneration per power).
tech_invocation_desc: Unlocks the Abundance spell (instant: 10 crystals ➔ 1000 gold).
tech_troop_summoning_desc: Unlocks the Troop Summoning spell (instant: 100 crystals ➔ +100 soldiers in a targeted ally city).
tech_arcane_edification_desc: Unlocks the Arcane Edification spell (instant: 2000 crystals ➔ makes a fully developed city appear on any free location reached by one of your roads, with no placement restriction).
tooltip_steel_weapons_checkbox: Steel Weapons: costs 1 extra Steel, produces {0} soldiers at once
tooltip_toggle_steel_weapons: Activate / Deactivate Steel Weapons for all barracks
tooltip_toggle_weaponsmith: Activate / Deactivate production for all weapon smiths
tooltip_toggle_armorsmith: Activate / Deactivate production for all armor smiths
tooltip_toggle_alchimisthut: Activate / Deactivate Healing Potion production for all alchemist huts
tech_advanced_tactics_desc: Unlocks automatic reinforcement between allied cities
tech_vendetta_desc: Unlocks automatic raids on a civilization, after a manual raid or a suffered attack
tech_surveillance_desc: Lets you actively attack a monster at distance 2 if the city has a Watchtower
tech_watchtower_construction_desc: Every new outpost automatically receives a Watchtower
tech_great_lighthouse_construction_desc: Unlocks construction of the Great Lighthouse, a monument (coastal terrain) granting prestige and range bonuses as it levels up
prestige_tooltip_unlocks_ranged_monster_: unlocks attacking monsters at distance 2 (with a Watchtower)
tooltip_wonder_surface_only: ⚠ Wonders can only be built on the surface
tooltip_wonder: Build a Wonder on a hex in your territory — must be far enough from enemy cities
tooltip_great_lighthouse_surface_only: ⚠ The Great Lighthouse can only be built on the surface
tooltip_great_lighthouse: Build the Great Lighthouse on a coastal hex in your territory
tooltip_observatory_surface_only: ⚠ The Observatory can only be built on a surface Mountain
tooltip_observatory: Build the Observatory on a Mountain in your territory — each level lowers the research-point cost multiplier of Void routes
tooltip_necropolis_abyss_only: ⚠ The Necropolis can only be built on unpurified Divine Bones, in the Abyss
tooltip_necropolis: Build the Necropolis on unpurified Divine Bones in your territory — the bones are destroyed, and each level raises the Divine Points earned on Ascension by 10%
tooltip_necropolis_harvest: Build the Necropolis on unpurified Divine Bones in your territory — Greater Purification harvests their divine essence for free, and each level raises the Divine Points earned on Ascension by 10%
wonder_select_hex: Choose a hex adjacent to one of your cities — must be far from enemy cities
great_lighthouse_select_hex: Choose a coastal hex adjacent to one of your cities — must be far from enemy cities
observatory_select_hex: Choose a Mountain adjacent to one of your cities — must be far from enemy cities
necropolis_select_hex: Choose unpurified Divine Bones adjacent to one of your cities — construction will destroy them
necropolis_select_hex_harvest: Choose unpurified Divine Bones adjacent to one of your cities — construction will harvest their divine essence
event_wonder_placed_body: Your civilization has laid the first stone of a Wonder.
event_great_lighthouse_placed_body: Your civilization has laid the first stone of a Great Lighthouse.
event_great_lighthouse_levelup_body: Your Great Lighthouse has reached level {0}.
event_observatory_placed_body: Your astronomers have claimed the Mountain. Invest to start charting the Void.
event_observatory_levelup_body: Your Observatory has reached level {0} — Void routes now cost less.
event_necropolis_placed_body: The Divine Bones have been sealed under the foundation stone. Invest to raise the Necropolis.
event_necropolis_levelup_body: Your Necropolis has reached level {0} — the next Ascension will grant more Divine Points.
task_harvest_wood_desc: Click on a forest hex adjacent to your city to harvest wood.
task_harvest_brick_desc: Click on a hill hex adjacent to your city to harvest bricks.
task_build_seaport_desc: Gather enough resources, click on your city and build a Seaport.
task_build_sawmill_desc: Gather enough resources, click on your city and build a Sawmill.
task_build_brickworks_desc: Gather enough resources, click on your city and build a Brickworks.
task_build_first_road_desc: Click on a free edge around your city to build a road.
task_harvest_food_desc: Click on a meadow hex adjacent to a city to harvest food.
tutorial_step_harvest_desc: Select a hex adjacent to your city and tap it to harvest resources. Forest hexes give Wood, hill hexes give Bricks.
tutorial_step_production_buildings_desc: Production buildings automatically harvest resources from hexes adjacent to your city, without any input. This automatic harvesting stacks with your manual harvests.
tutorial_step_build_desc: Tap your city to open the build menu. Select an available building and construct it.
tutorial_step_road_desc: Build roads to expand your territory. To found a new city, you need to reach a vertex at least 3 roads away from your first city.
task_build_second_city_desc: Extend your roads 3 segments from your city, then click a free vertex to place an outpost and found a new city.
task_build_second_townhall_desc: Build a Town Hall in your new city to develop it.
task_upgrade_production_level2_desc: Click on a city, select a production building (Sawmill, Brickworks…) and press Upgrade.
task_build_10_cities_desc: Extend your road network and click on free vertices to found new cities.
task_build_5_libraries_desc: Gather enough resources and build a Temple in each city.
task_build_5_palisades_desc: Gather enough resources and build a Palisade in each city.
task_build_10_production_desc: Build Sawmills, Brickworks, Mills, and other production buildings in your cities.
task_build_5_cities_desc: Extend your road network and found new cities.
task_seaport_townhall_level4_desc: Click on a city, select the building and press Upgrade until level 4.
task_seaport_level4_desc: Click on a city with a Seaport, select it and upgrade it to level 4.
task_townhall_level4_desc: Click on a city with a Town Hall, select it and upgrade it to level 4.
task_build_imperial_port_desc: Select a city with a level 4 Seaport and a level 4 Town Hall, then open the Unique Buildings tab.
task_build_2_warehouses_desc: Gather enough resources and build a Warehouse in 2 different cities.
task_build_1_warehouse_desc: Gather enough resources, click on your city and build a Warehouse.
task_build_market_desc: Click on your city and build a Market to unlock trading.
task_trade_10_gold_desc: Open the Sell tab in Trade and sell resources for gold.
task_build_3_warehouses_desc: Gather enough resources and build a Warehouse in 3 different cities.
tutorial_step_trade_desc: Build a Warehouse to store your resources, then sell resources for gold. Sell 50 resources to obtain 10 gold.
task_reach_20_victory_points_desc: Upgrade Town Halls to level 3 (2 pts), build Temples (1 pt).
task_perform_prestige_desc: Once the Imperial Port is built, click the Prestige button in the main interface.
task_reach_enough_victory_points_desc: Build Temples and Libraries, and upgrade your Town Halls to earn victory points.
tutorial_step_expansion_desc: Extend your roads to a free vertex, then found an outpost to create a new city.
tutorial_step_production_desc: Build production buildings in your cities to keep your empire supplied with resources.
tutorial_step_empire_desc: Expand your empire by building many cities. Upgrade your production buildings to increase your harvests.
tutorial_step_capital_desc: Unlock the Imperial Port by owning a level 4 Seaport and a level 4 Town Hall in the same city. It is a unique building.
tutorial_step_imperial_port_desc: Build the Imperial Port to unlock Prestige and open a new era.
tutorial_step_prestige_desc: Perform a Prestige to restart with permanent bonuses and unlock new possibilities.
tutorial_step_research_desc: Buy the Research vertex in the prestige map to unlock technologies, then start your first research.
task_buy_research_vertex_desc: Open the Prestige tab, buy the Research vertex at the center of the map to unlock technologies.
task_complete_first_research_desc: Open the Research tab, select a technology and wait for it to complete.
task_build_library_level_desc: Build a Library to earn research points.
task_build_3_libraries_desc: Build Libraries in your cities to increase your research speed.
task_build_barracks_desc: Unlock the Barracks via the prestige vertex, then build one in one of your cities.
task_buy_barracks_vertex_desc: Buy the Barracks vertex in the prestige map to increase the maximum level of your Barracks.
task_complete_military_buildings_researc: Complete the Military Buildings research to increase the maximum level of your Barracks.
task_build_2_barracks_desc: Build a Barracks in two different cities to have soldiers at multiple points.
task_create_reinforcement_flow_desc: Select a city with a Barracks and set a military flow toward another allied city to send reinforcements. Maximum range: 5.
task_destroy_enemy_city_desc: Attack and destroy a city belonging to another civilization. Maximum range: 3.
task_kill_bandit_desc: Your soldiers can attack and eliminate a bandit on the map.
task_perform_second_prestige_desc: Reach the required victory points again and perform a second prestige.
task_destroy_bandit_hideout_desc: Eliminate all bandits from a hideout to destroy it and increase your prestige gains.
tutorial_step_second_prestige_desc: Perform a second prestige to strengthen your civilization. Bandits and hideouts adjacent to a city with soldiers are attacked automatically — destroying them all increases prestige gains.
tutorial_step_barracks_desc: The Barracks trains soldiers for defense and attack. Unlock it via the prestige vertex or the associated research.
tutorial_step_reinforcement_desc: Link your cities with barracks using reinforcement flows to concentrate your troops where needed. Drag and drop from a city to a close enough allied city to create a flow.
task_place_wonder_desc: Open the Wonder tab and place it on a hex adjacent to one of your cities.
task_build_wonder_desc: Invest resources into the Wonder until it reaches level 1.
task_encounter_rats_desc: Rats have invaded one of your hexes. Harvest there is blocked until your soldiers drive them out.
tutorial_step_place_wonder_desc: Place the Wonder on a hex in your territory, far from enemy cities. That hex is sacrificed: it will never produce resources again.
tutorial_step_wonder_desc: Invest heavily in the Wonder to reach level 1. It will then multiply your prestige points by a bonus that grows with time spent on the island — including time before it was built.
tutorial_step_war_desc: Attack an enemy city to destroy it. Drag and drop from one of your close enough cities to the target city to launch the assault. You cannot build next to an enemy city, and contested territories produce nothing.
task_build_corruption_spire_desc: Build a Corruption Spire on a Corruption Source, in the Underworld (build menu).
task_perform_corrupted_prestige_desc: Once the Corruption Spire is built, choose the Corrupted Prestige option instead of a normal Prestige.
task_reach_corruption_level4_desc: Chain Corrupted Prestiges until the world's corruption level reaches 4.
task_build_corruption_spire_level4_sourc: Build a Corruption Spire on a level 4 Corruption Source (destroy and rebuild it elsewhere if needed).
task_open_abyss_gate_desc: Invest resources into the Abyss Gate, from your Corruption Spire's panel, until it is complete.
tutorial_step_corrupted_prestige_desc: A Corruption Source can appear on the Underworld's corrupted zones: build a Corruption Spire on it from the build menu. Once the Spire is complete, perform a Corrupted Prestige instead of a normal Prestige.
tutorial_step_corruption_level_desc: Each Corrupted Prestige raises the world's corruption level by one, making corrupted zones more dangerous (past level 3, corruption spills over to the surface). Chain Corrupted Prestiges until you reach corruption level 4.
tutorial_step_abyss_gate_desc: A level 4 Corruption Source can now appear: build a Corruption Spire on it and let it fully clean a level 4 corruption zone. The option to open the Abyss Gate then appears directly in your level 1 Corruption Spire's panel: invest resources into it to complete it.
task_build_void_road_desc: Build a road between two Void hexes, in the Abyss. Its research point cost rises with every Void Road already built.
task_purify_divine_bones_desc: Invest resources into a Divine Bones until it is fully purified, to gain a divine essence.
task_reach_five_divine_essence_desc: Reach 5 effective divine essences (essences held + Reliquary).
task_charge_divine_reliquary_desc: Perform a normal (non-corrupted) Prestige after unlocking the Sacred Reliquary, to keep part of your essence beyond the corruption cap. One of two ways to reach 5 divine essences.
task_build_necropolis_desc: Build a Necropolis on a hex bearing unpurified Divine Bones, to increase the divine points earned on your next Ascension.
task_reach_corruption_level5_desc: Chain one more Corrupted Prestige to raise world corruption to 5, which directly raises the divine essence cap. The other way to reach 5 divine essences.
task_perform_ascension_desc: Open the Ascension panel and confirm, once your effective divine essence reaches 5.
tutorial_step_void_road_desc: Link two Abyss outposts separated by Void by building a road across it, paid in research points rather than resources. Each new Void Road costs more than the last.
tutorial_step_purify_divine_bones_desc: Divine Bones appear in the Abyss once the Void Compass research is acquired. Invest resources to purify one: purification grants a divine essence, up to the cap set by your corruption level.
tutorial_step_five_divine_essence_desc: Ascension requires 5 effective divine essences. The cap on essence gained from Purification depends on your corruption level: two options, either one, let you reach it — perform a normal Prestige after unlocking the Sacred Reliquary, to keep part of it beyond the cap; or chain one more Corrupted Prestige to raise corruption to 5 and directly raise the cap. Either path alone is enough.
tutorial_step_ascension_desc: With 5 effective divine essences, Ascension becomes available. It converts that essence into divine points and starts a new cycle, with new divine powers and a race to choose.

ascension_confirm_warning: All Divine Essence will be converted into Divine Points (1 for 1). Your current island and Prestige progress will be permanently erased — you'll restart from the beginning with only your Divine Points.
ascension_no_powers_yet: Ascend at least once to reveal the divine powers.
ascension_power_faith_desc: Increases the Temple's max level by 3 and reveals the existence of the Dominion.
ascension_power_handofgod_desc: Automatically harvests every available manual resource as soon as its cooldown allows it.
ascension_power_divineinventory_desc: Increases the civilization's storage capacity by 1000%.
ascension_power_hornofplenty_desc: Grants +100% yield to every automatic harvest, in all your cities and whatever the building — stacks with the other yield bonuses, which can push a harvest beyond double. On top of that, a divine bounty of 20 units of each basic resource (Food, Wood, Brick, Stone) is granted to the civilization every second.
ascension_power_eyeofgod_desc: Reveals the entire surface map, the whole technology tree and the entire prestige map.
ascension_power_memoryofgod_desc: Reduces the cost growth of repeatable research by 50% (×1.5 per relaunch instead of ×2), and shields them from Ascension: every new cycle starts back at the highest rank ever reached.
ascension_power_walkofgod_desc:
► Transforms the terrain of a hex under Dominion of level 2 or higher, consuming 1 Dominion level (civilization action, works on water too)
► The first walk after each prestige is free, then the cost doubles with every walk — and halves again every 12 h of game time, never dropping below 1
► A people bound to a terrain (Forest for Elves, Mountain for Dwarves, Water for Mermaids) grows it everywhere else; on that very terrain, the transformation is random
ascension_power_presenceofgod_desc: Manifests your presence over an area: dispels Corruption and spawns Dominion (5 points on the targeted hex, 3 on each neighbor — civilization action). The first manifestation after each prestige is free, then the cost doubles with every manifestation — and halves again every 12 h of game time, never dropping below 1.
ascension_power_armofgod_desc: Every soldier attack deals 1 extra damage, against monsters as well as enemy cities — stacks with Steel Weapons.
ascension_power_fistofgod_desc: Brings the divine fist down on a hex under Dominion, consuming 1 Dominion level: 100 damage to the monster standing there and to each adjacent enemy city (civilization action, works on every layer). The first strike after each prestige is free, then the cost doubles with every strike — and halves again every 12 h of game time, never dropping below 1.
ascension_power_wrathofgod_desc: Grants +100% attack speed to your soldiers, against monsters as well as enemy cities — stacks with the other attack speed bonuses.
ascension_power_greaterpurification_desc: The Necropolis purifies the Divine Bones it is built on instead of destroying them: their divine essence is harvested for free on construction, with no crystals or research points. The Divine Reliquary can now hold twice as much essence (2 with the Sacred Reliquary alone, 4 with the Reinforced Reliquary).
ascension_power_divineconstruction_desc:
► Every new outpost is granted a level 1 Town Hall
► Plus every basic production building (Sawmill, Brickworks, Mill, Quarry) its terrain actually allows
► Plus a level 1 Market on any terrain
► Guilds that automate building construction now perform two constructions/upgrades per cycle instead of one
ascension_power_divineconquest_desc:
Every new outpost is granted:
► A Palisade (level 2 if the Fortified Outpost prestige vertex is owned, the two stacking)
► A level 1 Barracks
► Up to 20 garrisoned soldiers (fewer if the city's capacity is lower)
ascension_power_divinemagic_desc:
► Spells can accumulate up to 5 launch charges when their cooldown completes with no accumulated exhaustion
► Casting a spell with a charge available consumes it without accumulating exhaustion
► Each prestige grants back 1 charge per spell
ascension_power_divinerituals_desc:
